Transforming Software Change Management

Smart Impact Analyzer is an AI-based Requirement Change Impact Analysis System designed to help software teams understand the consequences of requirement modifications.

The system uses Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques to analyze requirements, identify affected modules, detect dependencies, and predict potential risks before implementation.

{/* Right Side */}

Project Highlights

  • AI-based Requirement Analysis
  • Automated Impact Prediction
  • Dependency Detection
  • Risk Identification
  • Intelligent Reports Generation
{/* Mission Vision */}

🎯 Our Mission

To reduce software development risks by providing accurate AI-based impact analysis for requirement changes.

🚀 Our Vision

To build smarter software engineering solutions that improve productivity and decision making.
